summary: Iteration 2: tested the three new features (Relationship links, Thinking timeline, Assumption check) end-to-end plus regression. Backend pytest suite grew from 17 to 28 tests, 100% pass in ~6s. Playwright flow logged in demo user, created a new analysis, moved to See stage, verified links-need-items when <2 items, added 2 patterns items, added a link via link-from-select / link-to-select / link-note-input / add-link-kind-unknown / link-add-btn, confirmed row link-{id} and dashed arrow map-link-{id} render, duplicate link produced the 'already exists' toast, timeline-open-btn opened timeline-sheet showing timeline-group-0 with created+item_added+link_added events, deleted the link, marked an item as unknown via item-mark-unknown-{id}, confirmed item-check-{id} appeared only for non-known items (1 check for 2 items), reopened timeline and saw item_relabelled + link_removed events, clicked item-check which auto-sent a user message starting 'How could I check this?' to the Guide, and on mobile 390px guide-open-btn remained visible. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_analyses.delete_item: pulls links in two sequential update_one calls instead of a single $pull with $or; works but costs 3 writes per item deletion. Minor.
routes_analyses.add_link: duplicate detection is directional only (A->B blocks only A->B, not B->A). Product-wise that may be intentional ('may influence' is directional) — fine, but confirm with PM.

TimelineSheet effect depends on `version` (analysis.updated_at) to re-fetch; stage-only PATCHes still bump updated_at in save_and_return, so timeline refetches without new events. Harmless but a redundant GET.

LinksSection filters options by MAP_SECTIONS; if a user adds items only in sections NOT in MAP_SECTIONS (e.g., leverage, boundaries) the UI will still show links-need-items even with >=2 items. Verified MAP_SECTIONS includes stakeholders/patterns/loops/in_scope/assumptions/relationships/out_of_scope per spec — OK.

Workspace askGuide calls guideRef.current?.ask without checking if ref is attached when aside is hidden on desktop; works because aside is rendered (hidden class) so GuidePanel mounts. If aside stops mounting while hidden this will silently fail.
No rate limit on POST /analyses/{id}/links; a user could spam create+delete to pollute timeline. Low priority.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_a_/TEST_b_ users and TEST_links analyses; frontend created TEST_links_fe analysis under demo user (not cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Links+timeline+assumption-check pass. Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (28 tests). Known testids used: links-section, links-need-items, link-form, link-from-select, link-to-select, link-note-input, add-link-kind-known|unknown, link-add-btn, link-{id}, link-delete-{id}, links-count, map-link-{id}, timeline-open-btn, timeline-sheet, timeline-group-0, timeline-loop-N, timeline-event-{kind}, item-check-{id}. Auth testids are auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-btn (NOT signin-*). New analysis route is /analysis/new. One leftover TEST_links_fe analysis on demo user — fine to delete.
